links.reported_relation: updateLaunchpadLPVault() changes where new LP tokens are minted, but the factory and pairs continue to reference the old launchpadLp, so pairs measure balanceOf on the stale address while LP tokens are minted to the new vault.
The factory stores launchpadLp and launchpadFeeDistributor as constructor-time constants and embeds them into each pair at initialize(), so new pairs cache the old vault address.
